mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals a strong accommodative monetary policy stance, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is declining, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous quarter signals a strong supply-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2%, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for two months, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a favorable environment for consumer spending and investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases and CPIAUCSL decreases, or if the joint effect of HOUST and CPIAUCSL on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases for 3 months and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases and UNRATE decreases, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and UNRATE on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
